column1: # The host framework's refusals of a params object, before it looks for a node. Read by host_refusals() in tools/matter-generate.py.
# MEASURED by tests/backports/host/matterdifferential/probe-params-modes.m (round 8): each row was seen refused in the modes
# named in its last column. The member is a key path; a struct member is named through its struct
# kind: nil         the member is absent (a struct member that is nil)
#       nil-or-zero the member is absent or zero (an NSNumber the framework reads as zero)
#       zero        the member is present and zero; an absent member is accepted
#       one         the member is present and one, a value the framework reserves
# Not listed, because the probe could not separate them: the members of a struct that is itself nil (the probe leaves a
# nil struct nil in every nil: and one: mode), and the nodeID of AddACLToNode (nil with aclEntry nil in every mode).
# answer: MTRInteractionErrorDomain/135, "Out of range error or set to a reserved value." on every row.
